cases.title: I-Shaped Special Structural Shear Wall
cases.summary: An spColumn reference example for axial force and bending in an I-shaped reinforced concrete wall.
cases.description: This case compares the saved RETUG concreteJS wall model with StructurePoint’s spColumn control points. The plot shows the supplied 90° analysis: 100 nominal and factored profiles, including both moment directions. The bundled model includes all 16 published control points as demand checks.

source.title: StructurePoint — spColumn v10.10
source.report: DE Special Structural Shear Wall – Compressive Stress, ACI 318-19 (October 12, 2023)
source.page: spColumn report page 6 (PDF page 36), Control Points

cases.title: Plated Composite Shear Wall — SpeedCore Example 3-2
cases.summary: An AISC SpeedCore worked example compared at a fixed axial load in Mx–My space.
cases.description: This case compares a RETUG concreteJS fixed-P M–M result with the AISC plastic-moment point for Example 3-2, a plated composite C-shaped shear wall. The supplied model retains the P = 0 and P = -3,770 kip demand cases so the example can be opened directly in the application.

source.title: AISC Design Guide 37 — SpeedCore Example 3-2
source.report: Seismic Design of Uncoupled 18-Story SpeedCore Walls, plated composite concrete shear wall

details.label: Section
details.value: Uncoupled C-shaped SpeedCore wall; 120 in flange length × 480 in wall depth

details.label: Concrete
details.value: f′c = 6 ksi; 17 in concrete cover regions inside 0.5 in plates

details.label: Verification load
details.value: P = -3,770 kips; RETUG Mx and My are plotted at fixed P

details.label: Published result
details.value: AISC plastic-moment point: Mx = 731,416.67 kip-ft, My = 0
